purpose: Places Johnny Silverhand speaks up about when V arrives (Johnny speaks up, step 2: mod/johnny-remarks.lua M.PLACES, bridge/johnny-head.mjs PLACES). For each place: the gamedataDistrict enum names that trigger it and their parent chain in the game's District records, the phrase the bridge words, and a short note written to Johnny in the second person, taken only from his intrinsic claims, his profile and the knowledge rules he is told (directly or as the engram that shares V's senses, native-cowitness.json). A note gated on a head milestone is said only when that milestone is in the head field; an altNote needs a fact or journal entry the head field does not carry. An empty note means the remark goes on the place name alone.

conventions.districts: Enum names (tweakDBEnums.script gamedataDistrict) that put V at the place. Matching walks V's chain from the most specific record up, so a district entry also covers every record under it; the most specific place on the chain wins.
conventions.level: venue: one record (an interior or a named site). district: any record under the listed roots.
conventions.gate: 'none': true whenever Johnny is in V's head (after q101_done, before an ending). Otherwise a head milestone id of mod/johnny-head.lua M.MILESTONES.
conventions.altGate: What the altNote needs instead: facts (name, test, verified writer) and/or journal entries (cooked journal path, class, state), with the knowledge rule that pins them. The altNote replaces the note when its gate is met.
conventions.vehicle: true: an arrival read while V is in a vehicle counts (open districts V drives into). false: a reading while V is mounted in a vehicle should not count as being at the place (interiors and estates whose volume may reach the street), so the arrival is the first reading on foot.
conventions.evidence: Paths relative to gameRoot, file:line or file:first-last.

places.altNote: Here V paid Rogue for the Hellman lead, and she sent V on to Panam. You were along for it, in V's head.
altNoteSources: evidence jr-priority.rogue.commission: q103_rogue_done is written in the Afterlife phase (q103_01_afterlife_new.questphase)
places.remarks: No claim, profile line or Johnny-known rule names the Afterlife in its text. The only grounded line is the q103 payment to Rogue, which the rule's evidence places in the Afterlife phase. Visited often (Rogue, Nix, gigs), so a 4 h cooldown.

places.phrase: Corpo Plaza, City Center, where Arasaka Tower stands
places.note: You say you took Arasaka Tower down in 2023 for Alt. That is your account: the records disagree on who did it and how many died, and your codex says you died in that attack.
places.altNote: You say you took Arasaka Tower down in 2023 for Alt, and V has lived through your memory of that raid. The records disagree on who did it and how many died.
evidence: tweaks/base/gameplay/static_data/database/fasttravel/districts.tweak:382-441 (ArasakaTowerLobby, Jungle, Atrium, Nest, SaburoOffice, Jenkins, UnlistedFloors, UpperAtrium, CEOFloor: each parentDistrict Districts.CorpoPlaza)
places.remarks: The note keeps the 2023 bombing as his account (tower-for-alt is only-with-explicit-self-perspective) and the records as disputed; it says nothing about the present tower being rebuilt (no claim does). The tower interiors are reached only in endgame missions, where he is busy, so the plaza is the real trigger. V's Corpo Plaza apartment (CorpoPlaza_Apartment) is under CorpoPlaza and matches too; the arrival is counted on entering the plaza, not on going indoors, so the long cooldown is what keeps a Corpo Plaza home from hearing it often. The altNote's journal quest (Love Like Fire) is part of Playing for Time, so it is probably always succeeded after q101_done; not verified here.

places.altNote: At Embers Hanako offered to lead V to Mikoshi under Arasaka Tower if V testified against Yorinobu. That was her offer; you heard it from inside V's head.

journal.writer: base q115_00b_hanako scene node 1228, end of the Embers conversation

places.remarks: Nothing of his own about Embers. The Hanako meeting is Nocturne Op55N1, just before the point of no return; the save the game returns to after the credits is after it, so the altNote matters mostly there. Whether Embers can be entered outside that quest is not checked; if not, the trigger never fires.

places.note: In the Voodoo Boys' data fortress Maman Brigitte pulled a fragment of you off V's chip and sent V into the deep Net; you and V reached Alt beyond the Blackwall.
noteSources: voodoo-queen.transmission.alt-dive (zz-cast-knowledge-20261018b.json; Johnny as co-witness; gated on q110_made_contact_with_alt, the alt milestone's own fact)
evidence: tweaks/base/gameplay/static_data/database/fasttravel/districts.tweak:571-616 (Coastview children incl. BattysHotel, GrandImperialMall, VDBChapel, q110Cyberspace)
places.remarks: The note does not claim the dive happened in Pacifica (no rule says where the data fortress is). Pacifica is where it fits because the game's own district record lists the Voodoo Boys as a Pacifica gang and the q110 cyberspace record sits under Coastview. Without the alt milestone the remark goes on the name alone. Dogtown is not under Pacifica in the records (separate place below).

evidence: tweaks/base/gameplay/static_data/database/fasttravel/districts.tweak:153-371 (Badlands_* records: each parentDistrict Districts.Badlands; LakeHut under LagunaBend under Badlands)
places.remarks: Three separate roots, so all three are listed. MorroRock (NCX) and Langley_Clinic are their own roots and left out. No claim or Johnny-known rule is about the Badlands at large (Ghost Town's Raffen Shiv detour and the Sunset Motel are not tied to a record); his one Badlands memory is on the oil-field venue so it is not said twice. A border the player crosses often, so the longest cooldown.

places.phrase: the North Sunrise oil field, the Badlands
places.note: At the oil fields V gave you one last chance, and you said you would try.
places.remarks: The rule says only 'the oilfield'; nothing read here ties the grave scene (sq031_05_grave) to this record, but it is the game's only oil-field district record. Medium confidence, so the note says 'the oil fields', not 'here'. Without the second chance the remark goes on the name alone (a refusal has no verified fact). The phrase spells the record name; the localized name (LocKey#78523) was not read.

tweaks/ep1/gameplay/static_data/database/fasttravel/districts.tweak:4-35 (Akebono, Expo, Hideout, CapitanCaliente, Cynosure: parentDistrict Districts.Dogtown)

hierarchyNotes: Every gamedataDistrict enum value has exactly one District record (base or ep1 districts.tweak) and vice versa; nothing else in REDmod's tweaks sets parentDistrict.
Roots (no parentDistrict): Heywood, Pacifica, Watson, Westbrook, SantoDomingo, CityCenter, Badlands, SouthBadlands, NorthBadlands, Dogtown, MorroRock, Langley_Clinic, Dogtown_Brooklyn.

Dogtown is a root, not under Pacifica; its base record is in base districts.tweak:125 and five children are in ep1. Dogtown_Brooklyn (ep1:39) has no parent at all, so a chain walk from it never reaches Dogtown.

The Badlands are three roots: Badlands (most Badlands_* children, the oil field among them), SouthBadlands (farms, trailer park, q201SpaceStation) and NorthBadlands (no children). MorroRock holds NCX.

Corpo Plaza is under City Center and holds the nine Arasaka Tower interiors, V's Corpo Plaza apartment and q201Cyberspace. The Arasaka Tower records are CorpoPlaza_ArasakaTower{Lobby, Jungle, Atrium, Nest, SaburoOffice, Jenkins, UnlistedFloors, UpperAtrium, CEOFloor}.
The Totentanz record is spelled Northside_Totentaz (record Totentaz).

There is a district-change event: PreventionSystem.OnDistrictAreaEntered(DistrictEnteredEvent) (preventionSystem.script:3713) feeds DistrictManager's stack (districtManager.script:142-200), which also writes UI_Map.currentLocationEnumName to the blackboard on every change. The delamain-cab add-on already observes PreventionSystem.OnDistrictAreaEntered (probe.log). It fires on both entering and leaving an area, so a sampled read stays simpler; it is noted here because the design doc says no such event was found.
